SP_APT=$(command -v apt-get 2>/dev/null || true); SP_DNF=$(command -v dnf 2>/dev/null || true); SP_YUM=$(command -v yum 2>/dev/null || true); echo "===SHELLPILOT-SECPM==="; if [ -n "$SP_DNF" ] || [ -n "$SP_YUM" ]; then echo dnf; elif [ -n "$SP_APT" ]; then echo apt; else echo none; fi; SP_PMB="$SP_DNF"; [ -z "$SP_PMB" ] && SP_PMB="$SP_YUM"; echo "===SHELLPILOT-SECCHECK==="; if [ -n "$SP_PMB" ]; then "$SP_PMB" -C -q --security check-update 2>&1 || true; elif [ -n "$SP_APT" ]; then "$SP_APT" -s -o Debug::NoLocking=true upgrade 2>&1 | grep -E "^(Inst |E: )" || true; fi; echo "===SHELLPILOT-SECLIST==="; [ -n "$SP_PMB" ] && { "$SP_PMB" -C -q updateinfo list security 2>&1 || true; }; echo "===SHELLPILOT-SECSUM==="; [ -n "$SP_PMB" ] && { "$SP_PMB" -C -q updateinfo summary 2>&1 || true; }; true
